what_this_is: Words and answers for src/close-many.mjs, which closes up to max_items waiting jobs in one call: each is closed as handled (with its one-line reason) or gathered into one digest job. A job made from the person's own words is finished only once its message's decision (method message-intake) is decided; its answers are below, filled with {meaning}, {reason} and {outcome}, and the option chosen is the outcome row's decision_option. Two or more of the person's messages with no decision yet share one decision, worded by together. Its next action is nothing, so it is recorded as carried out (carried_out) in the same step and never handed to an AI later as a decision whose next step was not done. Adding an outcome is a row in outcomes.

message-meaning.source: Sorted with the other waiting work before any full AI run.

message-result.result: No new action from this message: {reason}
message-result.check: The chat it came from shows it handled, or the digest carries it to the person's AIs.

asks.reason_none: Sorted as needing nothing more of the person's AIs: {reason}

decide.next_action: None from this message: it was {outcome}.
decide.success_measure: Nothing further is asked of the person's AIs by this message.

carried_out.what_happened: Nothing was asked of the person's AIs: the message was {outcome} when it was sorted ({reason}).

together.goal: {count} of the person's messages, sorted together as needing nothing more
together.meaning: {count} messages from the person, each kept as a fact of this decision in their own words.
together.reason: Each message, and why it asks nothing more: {reasons}

digest_job: Information that arrived for the person and asks for nothing; {count} items are in `arrived.items`, each with why it was gathered here. Read them for anything that bears on what the person is pursuing (list_pursuits); act on that if anything does, and finish saying what, if anything, you did.
